messages:
noah: ran a quick pass on the SLO slider interactions. left comments on Figma. main ask: make the guardrail states explicit in the control (recommended zone, warning zone, fallback zone). attaching screenshot.

irene: +1 on zones. for the recommended zone we should show a subtle background band and an inline label: "Recommended: keeps 95th percentile < target". when user drags into warning zone show a compact banner: "Warning: this may increase cost or latency risk" with a link to learn more.

sam: question: what happens if the user sets the SLO below recommended and also sets a low min? do we auto-enable burst? my preference: do not auto-enable burst silently. instead surface a suggestion card: "Your configuration may violate SLOs. Consider enabling burst or raising min." with quick actions.

devops-bot: scheduled check: run smoke test in staging for ui/capacity-slo-zones at 02:00 UTC.

oliver: accessibility: slider thumb must announce the zone label (e.g., "Recommended zone") on change via aria-valuetext. Also ensure keyboard increments respect step sizes (0.5% for fine, 1% for coarse).

irene: UX copy tweak for suggestion card: "This configuration risks latency SLOs. Quick fix: raise minimum GPUs or enable transient burst." and add a small "Why?" link opening inline panel explaining metrics used.

noah: I added a micro-animation for entering/exiting the recommended band to give users context. keep it subtle. product note: avoid using color alone to convey zone distinction; also add iconography (shield for recommended, warning triangle for risk).

sam: edge-case: if customer is on Dedicated (reserved) plan where burst isn't allowed, suggestion card should offer an alternate: "You can request temporary capacity via support or change to a burst-enabled pool."

devops-bot: deploy started: ui/capacity-slo-zones -> staging

irene: small accessibility nit: the inline "Why?" expander must not steal focus; it should expand under the slider and be reachable by keyboard. use aria-controls to connect trigger and content.

oliver: will prototype aria-valuetext changes and the keyboard step variants. noah: can you add timing values for the micro-animation?

noah: animation: 120ms ease-in for entering band, 80ms ease-out for leaving. small scale; avoid motion for users who prefer reduced motion.

irene: action items: oliver -> aria-valuetext & keyboard steps, noah -> animation timing + figma update, sam -> suggestion card copy + Dedicated plan handling, me (irene) -> iconography and accessible zone labeling. i'll merge comments in Figma and schedule a 15-min follow-up after staging checks.

sam: will also draft telemetry events to record when users drag into warning/fallback zones.
